en: A sepia-toned historic postcard depicting a grand building with gothic-style arches and two towers, set among trees. Distinguished people in period clothing are depicted in the foreground, along with beach sand and chairs. Text appears in both Cyrillic and Latin script at the bottom, reading 'Маиоренгофъ' and 'Majorenhof.' Additional text along the left side in German states 'Verlag Hohensperger & Co., Kunstanstalt, Riga.' Various advertisements are plastered on the building.
